30 m resolution at nadir. Physics (first order): X = h (2.44 lambda/D + eps), with the
diffraction-limited spot (2.44 lambda/D, lambda = 4.2 um) and the line-of-sight jitter during the
integration time eps = 3 urad (allocated to attitude control). Off-nadir viewing is not modeled.
Send registered mission data within 30 min to up to 50 users. Time late = storage delay + processing.
The payload mass shall not exceed the bus payload capacity.
